packageRules.description: Do not manage this chart's own image in charts/*/values.yaml. The deployment template concatenates the two fields as '{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag | default .Chart.AppVersion }}', so a pinned digest lands in the tag field and renders 'ghcr.io/lukeevanstech/shelly-prometheus-exporter:@sha256:...' — a colon AND an @, which is not a valid reference and fails to pull. Renovate raised this twice (#6, closed; #23, regenerated after). 'tag: ""' is deliberate: it falls back to Chart.appVersion, which the release flow owns.
